title: Implement pre drive tight HPF with Q 1 2 resonant bump option
description:
Create Source/DSP/TightFilter.h and Source/DSP/TightFilter.cpp implementing a 2nd-order RBJ high-pass filter used as the pre-drive tight low-end control.

Requirements:
- Class TightFilter with prepare(double sampleRate), reset(), and process/processBlock methods operating on a single mono channel of samples (buffers pre-allocated in prepare()).
- Cutoff (tight_cut) parameter constrained to 80-400 Hz, driven by a multiplicative SmoothedValue (strictly-positive frequency domain) — do NOT construct the SmoothedValue inside the process loop.
- Two Q modes: standard Butterworth Q=0.707, and Precision Tight resonant mode Q=1.2 producing a +1.8 dB overshoot at cutoff.
- RBJ biquad coefficient computation recomputed on sample-rate change and on smoothed-frequency movement; coefficients derived only in prepare()/coefficient-update paths, never allocating in process.
- Flush denormals: apply juce::ScopedNoDenormals discipline at the call site and add a tiny-value flush (or use JUCE denormal-safe state) in the recursive state to prevent denormal stalls.
- No heap allocation, locks, file IO, or string construction inside process().

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ (existing DSP module conventions and namespace from phases a/b)
- CMakeLists.txt (how DSP sources are added to the target; do NOT modify it in this task)
- JUCE/modules/juce_audio_basics for juce::SmoothedValue and juce::ScopedNoDenormals (read only; never modify anything under JUCE/)

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/TightFilter.h and Source/DSP/TightFilter.cpp exist and declare/define class TightFilter
TightFilter uses a multiplicative juce::SmoothedValue for the tight_cut frequency and does not construct it inside the process loop
TightFilter supports Q=0.707 Butterworth and Q=1.2 Precision Tight modes with a +1.8 dB overshoot at cutoff in the resonant mode
RBJ biquad coefficients are recomputed on sample-rate change and denormals are flushed in the recursive state
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost compiles Source/DSP/TightFilter.cpp without errors
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.h, Source/DSP/MidVoicingFilter.cpp, Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.h, or Source/DSP/InputTrimStage.cpp
allocate heap memory, take locks, or construct strings inside the audio process loop

allowed: add private biquad state members and coefficient fields
choose internal helper for RBJ coefficient math
forbidden: change the DSP processing chain order
add parameters outside tight_cut and Q mode
